in_sanskrit.name: फाल्गुन
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: The one who is dear to Radha (Goddess of Love)

in_marathi.name: Phalgun
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Spring or Red
in_marathi.long_meaning: Phalgun हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The name Phalgun is derived from the Sanskrit word 'phalguna', which means 'red' or 'spring'. In Hindu mythology, Phalgun is the name of the month corresponding to February in the Gregorian calendar and is associated with the god of fertility, Agni.
